accessSeparation.method: Symmetric evaluated surface-edge sampling against exact triangle BVHs; Lipschitz distance bound includes half the maximum sample spacing.

physicalComponents.method: All original world-space positions, normals, UV0 and winding-preserving triangles at1micrometre/component precision; original material-map bytes. UV1 and irradiance may change.

cpu.method: Perspective-correct depth/ID raster of actual decoded normalized GLB positions, including retained source geometry. All photographed control/handle and caption interior pixels must first hit the electrical assembly.

rays.method: Exact triangle BVHs from decoded production GLBs; first electrical hit from each frozen native-mask sample is the target. Cast from three stations against all non-electrical retained and replacement triangles, excluding only a 0.3 mm endpoint tolerance.

webgl.method: Actual complete WebGL scene rendered with a flat depth/ID material; source-mask interiors eroded2native pixels, original electrical=green, replacement access=blue, all other visible geometry=red.

nativeControls.method: Blender single-sample native component IDs: at least 95% of each frozen 21 × 21 center window must hit the intended switch parts, rather than the white enclosure. Physical export equivalence is checked separately.

serviceClearance.dynamicDoor: Closed source door excluded because the appearance door operates separately on its original live pivot; browser verifies the round trip and rotation.
serviceClearance.method: Barycentric intersections of all retained source triangles above the floor, at the actual bilinearly interpolated route camera and eight14cm head-ring samples; the R03 profile includes the actual decoded replacement skins, tread and rail when present.

mountContacts.method: Bidirectional exact segment/triangle rays on authored mounting surfaces; all pairs must have actual intersections. Nearest-edge samples at 0.5 mm provide diagnostic gap positions. Existing structural target is read from decoded exported room triangles.

grid.manualReview: Ten4px control sheets and six complete browser views are reviewed separately. Generated per-cell measurements do not mean manual acceptance of every cell.
limits: Only obstruction correction is accepted. Existing caption alignment, small labels, generator, overhead equipment and engine insulation are not reconstructed in R03.
The two lateral camera stations test physical visibility; the panorama provides only one physical photographic station.

findings: All four large switches and six small switches, their handles and the existing caption areas are exposed. The former broad white interference across the large switches is removed.

Existing lower labels are simplified frames; printed content/alignment and the small key/tether shapes do not match VR and remain pending. Their geometry and orientation are deliberately preserved in this scope.
No old stair wall remains in the tested control/label interiors. Direct, oblique and lateral views show the clear column.

Three inferred small mount pieces close nine actual mesh contacts to the new casing and the existing main-deck stair-opening boarding lip. They are digital access adjustments, not hardware identified in the panorama.

Four diffuse atlases and three local probes were regenerated with final mounting geometry. No residual broad casing band was observed on the exposed controls. Static reflections during nominal inspection remain approximate.
The KOHLER, upper equipment, ceiling, engine insulation and broader room differences remain outside R03.

limits: La visita aporta una referencia de un Grande 36M; no confirma por sí sola la identidad de Luz de Mar ni medidas reales.
La aceptación R03 cubre la eliminación de interferencias ante los diez mandos y sus rótulos; no certifica la semejanza completa del cuarto.
Los mandos pequeños mantienen perfiles de llave, caída de cables y placas simplificados respecto de la VR. Esta corrección conserva esas piezas.
Tres piezas pequeñas cierran los apoyos del pasamanos y su terminal. Son ajustes digitales inferidos; no se identifican como herrajes observados en la VR.
Los textos pequeños, su alineación, el KOHLER, los equipos superiores y los acabados del aislamiento siguen pendientes.
La cuadrícula de 8/4 px mide todas las celdas del alcance. Generar o medir una celda no equivale a aprobar visualmente cada detalle.
La VR aporta una sola estación física. Las dos posiciones laterales comprueban visibilidad; no son referencias fotográficas adicionales.
El peldaño conserva su altura y una zona de apoyo digital de 30 × 23 cm; la barandilla continua pasa al lado opuesto por elección explícita. No son medidas certificadas del barco.
SwiftShader verifica corrección y recursos estimados. Sus tiempos no acreditan FPS en una GPU real.
Los reflejos locales son estáticos y aproximados durante el corte nominal.
